svg.text: 1. BARE 4.2 IN PANEL, 90.5 × 77.0 × 1.0, ON A 24-PIN FPC. CONFIRM OUTLINE AND ACTIVE-AREA OFFSET WITH THE DATASHEET.
2. FRAME AND TRAY BOND AT THE WALL WITH A 0.2 MM ADHESIVE RING, AS PHONES DO. NO SCREWS THROUGH THE FACE.
3. NFC: SMALL NTAG215 TAG BEHIND THE PANEL'S BOTTOM BORDER, CLEAR OF THE CELL. TEST READ RANGE.
4. PETG OR ASA, 0.12 LAYERS FOR THE FRAME. FACE DOWN ON A TEXTURED BED.
5. 1.2 WALLS AND A 0.8 LIP ARE THE PRINTABLE MINIMUM; A MACHINED ALUMINIUM FRAME CAN GO THINNER LATER.
